name: Active Recovery Spin
focus: Flush legs, parasympathetic recovery — deliberately easy

steps.description: Free spin, easy cadence, no pressure
Z1 upper / Z2 floor, cadence 88-95 rpm, HR <150 bpm. Drop to 70-88W if HR won't settle below 150.
Easy spin, cadence falls to ~70 rpm

name: Lower Body + Anti-Rotation Core
focus: Posterior chain, hip stability, spine-safe anti-rotation core — no spinal flexion under load
notes: 2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 11kg, 8x TRX split squat per leg, 15x banded glute bridge (pause 1s at top), 2x20m farmer's carry 2x6kg, 10x Pallof press per side (light band, hold 2s). 60-90s rest between rounds. No spinal flexion under load. Posture over load throughout.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and side, hip circles, 10x bodyweight squat, 10x bodyweight glute bridge
10x goblet squat 11kg → 8x TRX split squat per leg → 15x banded glute bridge → 2x20m farmer's carry 2x6kg → 10x Pallof press per side
Rest between rounds — walk around, breathe, check posture for next round
Kneeling hip flexor stretch, figure-4 or pigeon pose, seated glute stretch — hold each 30-45s
